title: Theorems D33, D33B & D34: 100% Exhaustive Proof of Non-Existence of G_40-Symmetric Block-Circulant Unitary Generators across Both QR and QNR Cosets for AME(20, 11) over GF(121) (3.545 Billion Pairs, Global Minimum 12 / 4,970 = 99.7586%) and Exact Phase Transition Threshold q_c(G_40, n=20) = 13
theorems: Theorem D33 (Exact 16-Fold Gauge-Reduced Exhaustive No-Go for the QR Coset U_12^dagger = +-U_12 of G_40 at q = 11)
Theorem D33B (Exact 24-Fold Gauge-Reduced Exhaustive No-Go for the QNR Coset U_12 = beta*H_0 with beta*conj(beta) = -1 in QNR_11, Achieving sub = 0 / 177 and Global Minimum 12 / 4,970 = 99.7586%)
Theorem D34 (G_20 Bi-Unitary Odd-Rank Subfield Liberation sub = 125 [0, 25, 0, 100, 0] and the Entropy-Orbit Tradeoff Law)
field_extension: GF(121) = GF(11)[alpha] / (alpha^2 - 7) (primitive 5th root of unity zeta = 3 in GF(11)^*)
symmetry_group: G_40 = (Z_5 x span(W_tilde) x span(R_tilde)) rtimes span(J_comp) acting on U in U(10, GF(121)) with 4,970 minor orbits (177 odd-Frobenius sub-orbits [2, 9, 24, 65, 77] + 4,793 even-Frobenius ext-orbits [1, 36, 336, 1695, 2725])

qr_coset_d33.chiral_phase_gauge: Since 11 == 3 (mod 4), gamma = 5*alpha = 55 in GF(121) satisfies gamma^2 = -1, conj(gamma) = -gamma, and gamma*conj(gamma) = 1. Conjugation by diag(I_5, gamma*I_5) in U(10, GF(121)) maps mode=1 (U_12^dagger = -U_12) bijectively onto mode=0 (U_12^dagger = U_12), and diag(I_5, -I_5) maps u_0 -> -u_0, restricting u_0 in {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} (4-fold reduction).
qr_coset_d33.aut_z5_gauge: Conjugation by diag(P_2, P_2) where P_2 permutes d -> 2*d mod 5 (order 4 in Aut(Z_5)) acts freely on all r=1..2 valid bases U_12 (4-fold reduction).

qnr_coset_d33b.coset_definition: U_12 = beta * H_0 where H_0^dagger = H_0, beta = g^5 = 74 in GF(121)^*, beta*conj(beta) = 10 == -1 in QNR_11, and omega_0 = conj(beta)/beta = 91 in U(1, GF(121)). Because det(U_12) = beta^5 * det(H_0) with beta^5 * conj(beta^5) = (-1)^5 = -1 in QNR_11, this coset is strictly disjoint from the QR coset.

combined_g40_exhaustive_summary.global_min_sub_bad_orbits: 0 / 177 (25 canonical hits in QNR coset D33B)
combined_g40_exhaustive_summary.critical_dimension_threshold: q_c(G_40, n=20) = 13 (AME(20, q) exists in G_40 for q in {13, 16, 17, 19} by Theorems D27B, D29, D28; 0 / 3,544,742,400 exist in G_40 across both QR and QNR cosets for q = 11 by Theorems D33 and D33B)
